title: Not worth it
text: Thought maybe they'd get better, but after 3 boxes it's obviously they're not even trying. Let's be honest, this is super cheap, made in China knick-knacks. They're buying the stuff in bulk and anyone can get an idea of how little they pay for it by surfing around various ali sites. A package deal should get the customer more value, not less. However there's too much greed involved here, unless you see the "mystery" as part of the value.
label: negative
